html.p: The MS Windows AD Objects application leverages admon(ActiveDirectory) data for building and updating AD object lookup files, and Windows Event Logs/Perfmon Counters, WinHostMon for data analytics. The KVStore lookup files can be leveraged for looking up AD attribute information of User, Groups, Group Policies, Organizational Units, and Computer AD objects.

This app contains updated dashboard files for the Splunk® for Windows Infrastructure app and Splunk® for Microsoft Exchange app. These updated dashboards replace the use of the SA_LDAPSearch (Splunk® Support for Active Directory) ldap queries in the searches/macros/dashboards to instead use the AD Objects lookup tables.

li.i: This application provides numurous dashboards and reports for analyzing your Active Directory objects as well as core Microsoft Windows. These are all provided within this application and do not depend on either the Splunk® for Windows Infrastructure or Splunk® for Microsoft Exchange applications

Splunk® Cloud environments that are leveraging either the Splunk® for Windows Infrastructure or Splunk® for Microsoft Exchange applications, where either corporate policies or Security practices prevent external access to AD Environment using the required implementations of the Splunk® Support for Active Directory LDAP Queries.

Splunk On-Premise environments that are leveraging either the Splunk® for Windows Infrastructure or Splunk® for Microsoft Exchange applications, where current implementations of the Splunk® Support for Active Directory LDAP Queries are seeing slow response times.
